resources.string: Is this a scam?
Signs to look out for, and safe ways to check
Was it a scam?
Parley can\'t hear the call. These are things scammers often ask for. If any of them come up, it\'s fine to hang up.
These are things scammers often ask for. If any of them came up, it\'s worth checking before you do anything.
Warning signs
Safe ways to check
They\'re rushing you
“Act now”, threats, or asking you to stay on the line
They want gift cards, crypto or a wire transfer
Real companies and officials don\'t take payment this way
They ask for a code, PIN or password
Even a code just sent to your phone. Nobody genuine needs it.
They want you to install an app
Or to let them into your phone or computer
They say your money needs a “safe account”
Your bank will never ask you to move money to keep it safe
A family member is in trouble and needs money now
Often from a new number. Call them on the number you know.
Ask your family safe word
Shows your question on the call screen
Hang up and call the official number
The one on your card, a statement or their website
Hang up
Then block or report the number on the next screen
Block this number
Report this number
This number never calls you
You\'ve only ever called them. Caller ID can be faked, so check it\'s really them before you share anything.
For numbers not in your contacts
Ask their name
